summary:
• OpenRouter API for Hugging Face models — an endpoint that lets developers call any open‑weight model on the Hub, automatically routing to the cheapest, fastest provider.
• Claude Code — Anthropic’s coding assistant packaged as a local CLI tool that auto‑activates Code Mode and improves multi‑agent workflow reliability.
• WebsiteBench — a benchmark that tasks an agent with recreating live websites, providing thousands of visual and functional checks to validate full‑stack scraping or UI‑generation agents.
• Ask Studio with Dynamic Thumbnails — YouTube’s AI assistant that generates video ideas and automatically serves the best thumbnail variant to each audience segment, boosting click‑through rates.
• Gemini Config Checker — a utility that verifies proxy settings from the perspective of a signed‑in Google AI Studio user, exposing region‑based blocks missed by HTTP probes.
• MIT Technology Review on AI safety — argues that safe AI needs external limits instead of internal monitoring, providing a framework for sandboxed runtimes and kill switches.
